analysis.summary: ABS Marine Services Limited reported a strong financial performance for FY26, driven by owned fleet expansion, disciplined execution, and effective cost management. Total income reached INR322.64 crores, EBITDA surged to INR152.55 crores, and profit after tax rose to INR80.80 crores. Management remains optimistic about the offshore and maritime sectors, supported by government initiatives and favorable demand-supply dynamics. The company plans to continue its fleet expansion and prudent capital allocation to support sustainable long-term growth. ABS Marine Services Limited reported consolidated total income of ₹322.64 Cr and a net profit of ₹80.80 Cr for FY26.

guidance.claim: Management expects a 10% increase in turnover from current levels for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management expects the EBITDA margin band of 45% to 50% to continue.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that ONGC is expected to release a tender for about 20 vessels.
demand_outlook.quote: See, demand is as of -- as we talk now, ONGC is asking for about 20-vessel tender is going to come.

demand_outlook.claim: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents as reported by Rystad Energy.
demand_outlook.quote: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company scheduled delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The total cost of acquisition for both new vessels, Hades and MPSV, was about $15 million.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

capex_expansion.claim: The company delivered an Offshore Support/Supply Vessel (MPSV) sourced from the international market.
The company received delivery of the offshore vessel AM Passion.

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis, total income for FY26 stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a growth of 75.05% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for FY26 increased by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, with the EBITDA margin expanding by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for FY26 rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with the PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.

margins_costs.claim: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a diversified fleet supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we operate a diversified fleet with offices in Mumbai, Kochi, Singapore, and Kakinada, supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of eight owned vessels, five are on long-term charter, two have recently come out of charter, and a third newly acquired vessel is headed for dry dock.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of the eight vessels that we own, five of them are on long-term charter, three of them -- two of them have just come out of charter, and third one is just we have acquired, so it has to go into the dry dock and then only come out and then only we put her in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: Top 10 clients contribute around 90% of revenue.
The company secured an offshore charter contract from Larsen & Toubro for an offshore supply vessel.
The company bagged a port services project at Deendayal Port with a contract duration of 3 years.

capital_allocation.claim: Bankers are comfortable with the current debt-equity ratio, and funding is not seen as a problem.
capital_allocation.quote: At this point of time with our debt-equity ratio the banks are also comfortable. I don't think we have overshot on the debt side. With adequate reserves and all, I think bankers are comfortable for lending at this point of time.

capital_allocation.claim: Tonnage tax is used to purchase another vessel, and such purchase is mandatory within 10 years.
capital_allocation.quote: So, this what we do is whatever is, you know, between the corporate tax and the tonnage tax is used as for purchasing of another vessel. And that is mandatory, within 10 years you have to do so much purchase.

risks_headwinds.claim: EPC contractors avoid working during the monsoon season due to safety risks and potential loss of life.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the monsoon, they cannot work. Considering risk of there was a huge loss of life and all that, so they are very careful that they should not work with during the monsoon time.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantee of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: The company is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company stays committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
